title: Item Auto-Balance (staff)
body:
Syntax: itemscale | itemscale preview <level 1-250> | itemscale <damage|armor|value|uses|healing|food> <25-400|+/-delta> | itemscale reset <field|all>

New staff-created weapons, armor, tools, medical items, and food automatically receive AutoBalance when ITEMTYPE is assigned in OSET. OCOPY also enables it on these newly copied items. Set OSET <vnum> LEVEL <1-250> and the resulting stats/healing are live; saved prototype fields are never rewritten. Existing item prototypes are not mass-changed.

Medical items: OSET CREATE <vnum> <name>; OSET <vnum> ITEMTYPE medical; OSET <vnum> LEVEL 100. By default medicine restores health gradually over 30 seconds. OSET <vnum> HEALFLAGS chakra or stamina chooses the resources. HEALTIME sets the duration. OSET <vnum> HEAL <positive amount> explicitly overrides the scaled amount; HEAL 0 restores automatic scaling.

Food: OSET CREATE <vnum> <name>; OSET <vnum> ITEMTYPE food; OSET <vnum> LEVEL 100. By default food restores Stamina instantly on EAT. HEALFLAGS health or chakra may be used to choose other recoverable resources; HEAL <positive amount> explicitly overrides scaling. Food recovery is NOT doubled a second time when AutoBalance applies. Existing saved food without AutoBalance uses its original recovery, including legendary exceptions.

Administrators may tune ITEM SCALE globally using ITEMSCALE HEALING 125 or ITEMSCALE FOOD 125, RESET HEALING|FOOD, and ITEMSCALE PREVIEW 100. The global percentage changes affect future consumption immediately; healing already started by medicine retains its original total. Recovery never exceeds the player's maximum pool. OSTAT shows the effective recovery per food or medicine item.

Existing manual bonuses, costs, healing and ingredient effects remain unchanged.
